subject.title: [Feature Request] Auto-linkify URLs in tool output cards (Control UI & WebChat)

question: Should completion require native macOS/iOS WebChat parity, or may a complete Control UI implementation close this issue with native parity tracked separately?
rationale: The browser implementation is bounded and clearly needed, but the issue includes native WebChat only “if applicable,” and combining both surfaces materially changes ownership, validation, and delivery size.

options.title: Control UI first
options.body: Accept complete safe linkification across all Control UI tool-card paths and track native parity separately if still desired.

options.title: Require both surfaces
options.body: Keep one acceptance boundary covering Control UI and native macOS/iOS WebChat before considering the issue complete.

recommendation.title: Control UI first
recommendation.body: Accept complete safe linkification across all Control UI tool-card paths and track native parity separately if still desired.

likelyOwner.reason: They are connected to the foundational renderer history and already framed the unresolved cross-surface acceptance question.
